title: Recording: Little Woman Love by Wings; Another Day by Paul McCartney | 1971
content:
Studio A-1, A&R Recording, New York City
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Dixon Van Winkle

Paul McCartney worked on the future Wings track ‘Little Woman Love’ on 21 January 1971.

This was the second consecutive day of work on the song, and saw McCartney continue recording acoustic and electric guitar parts. The song was released as the b-side of Wings’ second single ‘Mary Had A Little Lamb’.

In the afternoon McCartney finished recording ‘Another Day’, which would become his debut solo single later in the year.

The song had been mostly recorded on 12 October 1970, but still needed vocals. Six tracks were filled on this day. Two were for his double-tracked lead vocals; a third was for harmony vocals by Paul and Linda McCartney in the verses and bridge, plus five seconds of cheering and whooping. The fourth track was for high wordless harmonies; and the fifth and sixth were for additional harmonies.
